title: Non-overlapping Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals, find the minimum number of intervals to remove to make the rest non-overlapping.

steps.note: Initialize count to 0 and end to the first interval's end (2)
Compare current start (1) with end (2). 1 < 2, so overlap.
Compare current start (2) with end (2). 2 is not < 2, no overlap.
Update end to current interval's end (3)
